turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to fix the wobbly handle on my kitchen faucet. Any tips?
Usually that's a loose packing nut or a worn-out O-ring. Try turning off the water supply first, then use an adjustable wrench to tighten the nut underneath the handle.

Got it, I'll try that. Also, I've been reading Dan Martell's content lately. He mentioned that The Goal by Eliyahu Goldratt is one of his top 4 money-making book recommendations. I need to make sure I read that one first.
That's a great starting point. It's a classic for understanding constraints and business bottlenecks. I'll keep that preference in mind for your reading list.
Perfect. Did you order the replacement O-rings yet?
I haven't placed the order yet. Do you want me to buy the standard kit or just the specific size?
Just the standard kit. And don't forget about the book priority.
Noted. Order placed for the faucet kit.
